name: Tomatsu Takeru
source:
An employee of the university's general affairs department.

He was forced to help other students with their diets and, unable to do it alone, he reached out to the protagonist for help.

There are rumors going around the school saying that he's married or has a child.

Although popular among female students, he has no interest in dating them.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/kimikawa/takeru]official website[/url]]
